texts.at-0001: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes Reject invalid input in ledgerly modules by raising BillingError(code, detail) with snake_case codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; mirror the existing patterns in ledgerly/invoice.py and ledgerly/payments.py.
texts.at-0002: Reject bools when validating integer arguments When validating an int argument, exclude bool explicitly (isinstance(x, bool)) because True/False pass isinstance(x, int); use this in ledgerly/invoice.py and similar validators.
texts.at-0003: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ledgerly.clock.ensure_utc` before comparing or doing arithmetic; it raises `BillingError("naive_datetime")` for naive values. Follow the pattern used in `ledgerly.subscriptions.current_period`.

texts.at-0006: Use money helpers, never floats Convert amounts with ledgerly.money.to_money and round results with ledgerly.money.round_money; to_money rejects floats, so never do raw float arithmetic on money.
texts.at-0007: Module-level Decimal constants for literals Define numeric literals used in Decimal math as module-level Decimal constants (e.g. _HUNDRED = Decimal("100")) rather than inline ints or floats.
